newsitem.title: USA: Crystal Oil sets five-year natgas sale.
newsitem.headline: Crystal Oil sets five-year natgas sale.

text.p: Crystal Oil Co said Tuesday it sold about 16 billion cubic feet of natural gas to be delivered over the next five years for a current cash price of about $27 million.
The gas sold is expected to be produced from the natural gas properties recently acquired by the company located in DeSoto Parish, La.
It said the proceeds from the sale are being used to refinance the $12 million purchase price for the properties and to fund the development program for the field.
The sale proceeds will be reflected for financial accounting purposes as deferred revenues from the sale of gas and recognized as deliveries are made, Crystal said.

The company, however, does expect to recognize an increase in stockholders' equity of about $7 million, or $2.63 per share, due to the sale and the utilization of net operating loss carryforwards against a portion of the gain realized on the sale of the gas, it said.
